description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map1_s03.the_monster_lurks_is_the:
[The Monster Lurks]
is the book's title.{end}
strings.map1_s03.poltergeists_are_among_these:
{color 3}...Poltergeists are among these.
Negative emotions, like fear,
strings.map1_s03.worry_or_stress_manifest_into:
{color 3}worry or stress manifest
into external energy with
physical effects.
strings.map1_s03.nightmares_have_in_some_cases:
{color 3}Nightmares have, in some cases,
been shown to trigger them.
strings.map1_s03.however_such_phenomena_do_not:
{color 3}However, such phenomena do not
appear to happen to just anyone.
strings.map1_s03.hearing_this_the_hunter_armed:
{color 3}Hearing this, the hunter
armed with bow and arrow said,
[I will kill the lizard.]
strings.map1_s03.but_upon_meeting_his_opponent:
{color 3}But upon meeting his opponent,
he held back, taunting,
[Who's afraid of a reptile?]
strings.map1_s03.at_this_the_furious_lizard:
{color 3}At this, the furious lizard
hissed, [I'll swallow you up
in a single bite!]
strings.map1_s03.then_the_huge_creature:
{color 3}Then the huge creature
attacked, jaws opened wide.
strings.map1_s03.this_was_what_the_man:
{color 3}This was what the man wanted.
Calmly drawing his bow, he shot
into the lizard's gaping mouth.
strings.map1_s03.effortlessly_the_arrow_flew:
{color 3}Effortlessly, the arrow flew,
piercing the defenseless maw,
strings.map1_s03.this_is_from_an_old:
This is from an old fairy tale.
I remember reading it as a kid.{end}
strings.map1_s03.theres_a_drainage_valve:
There's a drainage valve.
Nothing unusual.{end}
strings.map1_s03.theres_a_hanging_key_its:
There's a hanging key.
It's just out of reach.{end}
strings.map1_s03.the_key_went_down_the: The key went down the drain.{end}
strings.map1_s03.the_ball_is_stuffed_inside:
The ball is stuffed
inside the pipe.{end}

Do you want to open it?{choice 4}
